query: SELECT ds.id, ds.settingDate, ds.restaurantId, r.name as restaurantName FROM daily_settings ds JOIN restaurants r ON ds.restaurantId = r.id WHERE ds.isActive = 1 ORDER BY ds.settingDate DESC LIMIT 10;
